in_marathi.name: Mithil
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mithil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mithila', which means 'the place of Mithila'. Mithila is a legendary kingdom in ancient Indian mythology, ruled by Queen Mithila. The name Mithil is a tribute to the beauty and grace of this queen.
